title: Short film edit, 'Last Ferry': ingest to multi-format delivery
domain: video editing (clip timeline, multicam, finishing, mix, delivery)
evidence_tree: origin tip c4d06841, read with git show and git grep; nothing built or run. lane/smb-harness-drive-1 (95af749d) is NOT merged into c4d06841 and is not counted as callable.
status_rule: callable: reachable through a RUN_COMMANDS id, a CLI subcommand, or a Viewer method / TimelineCommand that the viewer's panels call. The evidence starts with the surface: [cli] a process can call it today; [run] Rust call on hsk_studio_harness_core::Run; [viewer] Rust call on Viewer, or the egui harness panel. engine_only: crate logic and tests exist, no host calls it. missing: searched, not found; the evidence says where. Paths are relative to handshake-studio-assets/crates.
deliverable: A 4 minute 24 fps 1920x1080 short film in 3 story scenes (ferry deck dialogue shot on 3 cameras plus boom; cabin insert sequence; dawn ending), graded, captioned in 2 languages, mixed, delivered as: DNxHR HQ mezzanine, H.264 web master with AAC, HEVC UHD, 9:16 social cutdown with burned-in captions, WebVTT and SRT sidecars, audio stems, CMX3600 EDL.
input_assets: cam_a/b/c_*.mov: generated DNxHR LB 1920x1080 24 fps, moving colour pattern with burned-in camera id and frame counter, so an angle and a frame can be read from a pixel probe (generate with any test-pattern tool; hsk-studio-reel/tests/fixtures/dnx/dnxhr-lb-264x120.mov is the committed small fixture)
boom_*.wav: generated 48 kHz 24-bit mono, speech-band noise bursts with a known clap offset per take (for sync)
room_tone.wav, music_bed.wav: generated 48 kHz stereo, known LUFS
unknown.bin: arbitrary bytes for the import refusal
last_ferry.en.srt, last_ferry.nl.srt: authored by the runner, synthetic dialogue
ferry_look.cube: generated 33-point .cube identity plus known offset
workspace_or_layout_preset: Layout Preset `Edit` on the sequence profile default (STU-SHL-090@line32244), `Colour` for grading, both named in the proposed shipped set (STU-SHL-095@line32272; count and names are open decision OD-4). No Task Scope applies: the seven proposed ones hold no video edit scope.

coverage.could_it_run_today: No, not from empty to final. A Rust test harness could run the callable steps on a prepared package; a CLI process can only run the export-sequence steps. The result would be an ungraded, uncaptioned film whose multicam section shows one camera, with PCM audio in every file.
coverage.method_limits: Read, never run. Callable means the path was read, not that it passed. Status of a step whose text says UNVERIFIED stays as read.

runner_notes.multicam_check: resolve_active_angle: confirmed no caller outside pulse tests, by reading c4d06841, not run. Steps named CHECK carry the probe that would prove a fix: burn the camera id into each angle, set active_angle, assert shown_layers and the pixel id at every tick, in monitor and in export.
runner_notes.driving: At c4d06841 only export-sequence, batch and the document verbs are process calls; timeline.* is Viewer::timeline_command (harness-view/src/view/timeline.rs:1364). lane/smb-harness-drive-1 (95af749d, unmerged) adds state, command, undo and a stdin session with timeline.<key> and viewer.<method>. By its manual it refuses tool, edit_select, edit_point, rate_stretch, speed_duration and the export form, and its DRIVE_VIEWER names no source_edit, mixer_edit, multitrack_command or open_monitor, so most S1 and S3 steps stay Rust only after it lands. Check again when it merges.
runner_notes.fixtures: Prepared package with seq-main and all tracks (hsk-studio-harness/tests/cli_export_sequence.rs shows the shape); generated media with burned-in camera id and frame counter; speech-band audio with stated clap offsets; authored SRT files; a generated .cube. 24 fps = 10584000000 ticks per frame, 2000 samples per frame at 48 kHz.
runner_notes.features: media and audio-batch for monitors and mixer; os-encode with reel-native-mf-worker for H.264 and HEVC; av1-encode for AV1; media-native to decode H.264. A missing encoder is typed MEDIA_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE: record NOT_PROVEN, not a pass.
runner_notes.determinism: Use DNxHR for byte-stable comparison; OS encoders may vary by machine (UNVERIFIED). HeadlessClock and PresentEveryFrame for frame-exact monitor checks. Fix actor and session ids. Compare by decoded frame hash, receipt output_sha256 and per-bus sample difference within 1e-6 (the bound used in tests/viewer_timeline_export_bus.rs), never by screenshot alone.
runner_notes.gui_judging: Capture each Layout Preset at 1920x1080 and 1280x720 with the empty project, the assembled cut and the mix; judge the visual_check of each step, including overlap, truncated names and focus theft. Do not run scripts in the foreground.
runner_notes.stop_rule: Run scenes in order. A missing or engine_only step records its gap and continues with the fixture state it would have made, so later steps are still measured.
